name: byko-stack
description: Agent harness builder skill for Codex. The Claude Code work loop of byko-stack is not exposed to Codex.

interface.longDescription: Exposes one Codex skill, agent-harness-builder, which analyzes an existing or new project and builds agent-facing docs (AGENTS.md, docs structure) and lightweight executable guardrails. The Claude Code skills of this plugin stay under skills/ and are not listed for Codex; for a Codex work loop use byko-stack-codex.
defaultPrompt: Build an agent harness for this project.
Add AGENTS.md and a docs structure for coding agents.
Add lightweight guardrails that use this project's existing test and lint tools.
